c:
Unfortunately, completed server transfers cannot be reversed.

However, once the free server transfer period ends, server transfer vouchers are expected to become available for purchase, allowing you to transfer servers again.

Please note that no specific date or time has been announced for their availability yet, but they are expected to become available after the free transfer period ends.

If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to ask.

m:
Issue: User wants to transfer another character to a different server.
Resolution: Explained that the voucher is limited to one per account, but that it will be possible to purchase additional vouchers soon.

Issue: Player reported frustration with bots and cheaters affecting gameplay.
Resolution: Acknowledged concerns, confirmed daily bans and system improvements, and thanked player for their fair play and reports.
